text:
sarah_cs: quick FYI — during the nightly CRM cleanup we noticed playbook automations are firing on records with incomplete health inputs. looks like healthscore batching is using stale last_touch + missing owner fallthroughs. thinking we should: pause playbook triggers for a 2h maintenance window, run a normalization job, then recalibrate healthscore weights to include recent NPS and last_successful_login. thoughts? :thinking_face:

alex_ops: agree we should pause. propose window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC — lowest traffic. who needs to be notified? can we script a graceful pause/unpause? :calendar:

tina_analytics: ran a quick audit, results below. rough numbers: ~1,205 accounts with either null owner OR null last_touch; ~320 accounts have NPS but no recent activity. SQL I used: ```sql
SELECT count(*) as cnt, owner_id IS NULL as no_owner, last_touch IS NULL as no_touch
FROM accounts
GROUP BY no_owner, no_touch;
```
we should also weight NPS (last 90d) at +15% when present, and last_successful_login decay over 180d.

mike_csm: if we pause playbooks we need to update the "at_risk" threshold so we don't flood CSM queues when we resume. suggest temp bump from 45 -> 50 for 48 hours post-cleanup. also let's capture any open renewal windows and manually action the top 25 highest ARR.

sarah_cs: good call, mike. I'll create a manual queue for top-25 ARR to contact during the pause. alex, can infra run the pause as an automated toggle? sample config below — it's what we'll use to pause triggers tied to healthscore: ```yaml
playbook_pause_rule:
  name: crm_cleanup_pause
  match: "playbook.trigger == 'account.health < 40'"
  action: pause
  duration: 7200 # seconds
```

alex_ops: yep we can automate that. i'll wire this up to the deploy bot so it issues pause then runs normalization then unpause. will need a quick runbook: who approves, and a rollback plan if normalization changes break any external systems.

james_head_of_cs: approved for 02:00-04:00 UTC. please add a heads-up in the console banner and an email to the top 10 customers we might touch. also, add a retention of the pre-cleanup snapshot for 7 days. :ok_hand:

onboard_bot: Scheduled cleanup job started (job-id: cleanup-1800123456). will report progress.

onboard_bot: UPDATE — normalization in progress: 3 batches completed (300/1,205).

onboard_bot: ✅ normalization complete. 1,205 records normalized. 12 transient playbook runs were blocked during the window and queued for manual review. unpause triggered at 04:03 UTC.

tina_analytics: post-cleanup notes: recalibrated the healthscore formula to include NPS weight +15% and login decay. snippet of change: ```sql
-- healthscore pseudo formula
health = 0.4*usage_score + 0.25*engagement + 0.15*nps_present + 0.2*contract_tenure
```

sarah_cs: thanks team. next steps: (1) follow-up doc in Confluence with runbook + rollback link (https://confluence.redwood/example-cleanup) (2) update playbook automation to respect maintenance windows (3) alert in Console for large-scale normalization events. i'll own the follow-ups, tagging mike for top-25 outreach. :thumbsup:

mike_csm: got it. i'll draft outreach template, add renewal notes.

alex_ops: logging completed actions in infra runbook and creating an incident-lite record for audit.

james_head_of_cs: awesome. moving to done — great coordination. :party_popper:
